faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIPS Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the IIPS Research Fellow position is 13 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are sent via email before this deadline to be considered for the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there for Research Fellow posts in IIPS?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Fellow post at the International Institute of Population Sciences (IIPS) in this recruitment drive. Interested candidates should apply promptly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIPS Research Fellow jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIPS Research Fellow recruitment is Email. Candidates need to prepare their application with all required documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Fellow position at IIPS?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Fellow position at IIPS is Rs. 60000 - 80000 Per Month. This is a consolidated salary offered for the contractual role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for IIPS Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master Degree in Population Studies/Social Work/Psychology with a minimum of 2 years of experience in public health research and proven qualitative research experience to be eligible for the Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIPS Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for the IIPS Research Fellow Recruitment for any category, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates. Applicants can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIPS Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The selection process for the IIPS Research Fellow position primarily involves a Virtual Interview. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an online interview to assess their suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for IIPS Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The job location for the IIPS Research Fellow position is Mumbai, Maharashtra. Candidates selected for the post will be required to work at the International Institute of Population Sciences in Mumbai.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for IIPS?
faq.answer: The official website for the International Institute of Population Sciences (IIPS) is https://www.iipsindia.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and official updates regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for the IIPS Research Fellow post offline?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for the IIPS Research Fellow post is strictly via Email. Candidates are required to send their complete application and documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification, not through offline methods.
